video_title: Kevin Durant Press Conference: Suns vs. Rockets Postgame

quotes.speaker: Kevin Durant
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant on the team's fourth-quarter offensive execution
quotes.excerpt: we just kept the ball in our hands and made them shoot over us
quotes.quote: We hit some timely shots. We got stops. I know that sounds cliché and simple, but we gave up two and-ones to start the fourth quarter. We turned the ball over probably three times. So I think we just kept the ball in our hands and made them shoot over us and not foul, and we were able to cruise to the win.
quotes.social_post: Kevin Durant on the Suns fourth quarter adjustments against the Rockets: We hit some timely shots and got stops. We turned the ball over a few times early but kept the ball in our hands and made them shoot over us.

structured.context: Kevin Durant discusses the Phoenix Suns' offensive and defensive execution during the fourth quarter of their game against the Houston Rockets.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Durant
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant on reaching 33,000 career points
quotes.excerpt: I try not to make it about myself in there. I understand that it's rare
quotes.quote: I try not to make it about myself in there. I understand that it's rare to hit these type of accomplishments and I don't ever want to undersell it, but we're playing a team game and it's not about me most of the time. That's why I love my teammates who take a minute to celebrate anybody on individual accomplishments. We celebrate Alpi with his triple-double tonight. We've been doing that since I've been here. But someone who tried to just be one of the guys, I try not to make a big deal out of it.
quotes.social_post: Kevin Durant on reaching 33,000 career points: I try not to make it about myself. It is rare to hit these accomplishments and I do not want to undersell it, but we are playing a team game and it is not about me most of the time.

structured.context: Kevin Durant reflects on reaching 33,000 career points and praises his teammates for celebrating individual accomplishments like Alperen Sengun's triple-double.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Durant
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant on what he does with game balls
quotes.excerpt: I give them to my mom, I give them to my close friends, my agents
quotes.quote: I give them to my mom, I give them to my close friends, my agents, because they know I don't really lose track of them if I don't give them to them. I don't ever want to undersell some of that stuff, but I'm about to experience, like I've been through it, so it's cool enough for me.
quotes.social_post: Where do the game balls go? Kevin Durant says he gives them to his mom, close friends, and agents because he does not want to lose track of them.

structured.context: Kevin Durant explains what he does with the game balls he receives after reaching career milestones.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Durant
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant on exploiting the Rockets' defensive weaknesses
quotes.excerpt: we knew this team, they're good at iso defense
quotes.quote: We knew this team, they're good at iso defense. They are really good at plugging the lanes, getting steals and iso defense, so we just wanted to make a move a bit and then crash the glass. They're a small team. We knew them off of movement is not as disciplined as them in the iso, so we just tried to exploit that as much as possible.
quotes.social_post: Kevin Durant on the Suns game plan against the Rockets: We knew they were good at iso defense and plugging lanes, so we wanted to make them move and crash the glass. We knew their movement defense was not as disciplined as their iso.

structured.context: Kevin Durant describes the Phoenix Suns' strategy to exploit the Houston Rockets' defensive weaknesses during the game.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Durant

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: I know we've asked LeBron this question, we've asked you this question before, as far as when you know it's going to be time to walk away from the game.

text_blocks.speaker: Kevin Durant
text_blocks.text: Damn, son. Are you seeing like a little inclines of me being ready to be done? Like, damn. That's not, you didn't let me finish saying what I had to say.

quotes.excerpt: Are you seeing like a little inclines of me being ready to be done? Like, damn.
quotes.social_post: Kevin Durant had a funny reaction when asked about retirement: Damn son. Are you seeing like a little inclines of me being ready to be done? Like damn.

quotes.speaker: Kevin Durant
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant on maintaining his competitive fire
quotes.excerpt: I just love basketball. That's simple. I love to play ball.
quotes.quote: I just love basketball. That's simple. I love to play ball. I love everything about the game, all the details that add up to winning. I care about that. And I don't mind somebody got a grievance with me. I don't mind addressing it right there in the moment. I'm sure he has some, I said some things that he probably didn't like, and he addressed it right there, and I respect that as a man. And it didn't get further than that, but if it does get further than that, I'll be ready for that too.
quotes.social_post: I just love basketball. Kevin Durant on his competitive fire and handling on court grievances: I do not mind somebody having a grievance with me. I do not mind addressing it right there in the moment.

structured.context: Kevin Durant discusses his love for basketball and his approach to handling on-court conflicts with opponents.
